reason: The primary CIF is valid: it parses as primitive Pnma (No. 62), has cell 12.44592 x 3.66219 x 11.95741 angstrom, and symmetry-expands seven full-occupancy 4c sites to Y8Re4S16 (28 atoms, Z=4; reduced Y2ReS4) with explicit Y/Re ordering. Geometry supplies no hard chemical veto (minimum Y-S, Re-S, and S-S distances are 2.338, 2.467, and 2.543 angstrom), and the cell gives strong peak-position coverage. Exact atomic coordinates are nevertheless not established. For the selected-coordinate model, the trace's own instantiated intensity table predicts 0.83 versus 17.29 observed at 25.416 degrees 2theta, 6.02 versus 22.49 at 33.208 degrees, 2.24 versus 14.02 at 39.170 degrees, and 5.03 versus 12.66 at 50.551 degrees. An independent whole-profile calculation likewise gives an unweighted relative profile residual of about 27.2%, with residual peaks of +16.9 and +18.1 intensity units at 25.42 and 33.20 degrees against approximately 0.14 baseline noise. Multiple materially different Pnma coordinate minima occurred, while selection relied on a cosine-style integrated-intensity objective rather than convergent map/coordinate refinement or a Pawley-relative/Rietveld validation; no comparable Rwp was supplied. Strong indexing therefore does not rescue the important atomic-intensity failures, and another solution attempt is likely to add a materially different viable candidate.
